name: GitHub
description: 在侧栏查看、回复、关闭和重开当前项目的 GitHub issue 与 PR，也可查看 Actions 运行、失败原因与日志，并重跑或取消。会话里的 agent 也能调用，还能监听仓库的 PR、issue、@提及与 CI 失败，有事件才投递进会话。支持设备码登录，已登录的 gh CLI 可直接复用。侧栏可查看和停止所有会话的监听。

configuration.title: Personal Access Token（可选）
configuration.description: 不想用设备码登录时填写；需要 Issues、Pull requests 与 Actions 读写权限

agentTools.name: github_list
agentTools.description: List GitHub issues or pull requests of a repository (defaults to the current project's origin). Returns number, title, state, author, labels, url.

repo.description: owner/name; omit to use the current project's GitHub origin

agentTools.name: github_view
agentTools.description: View one GitHub issue or pull request with its body and comments.

repo.description: owner/name; omit to use the current project's GitHub origin

agentTools.name: github_comment
agentTools.description: Post a comment (Markdown) on a GitHub issue or pull request.

repo.description: owner/name; omit to use the current project's GitHub origin

agentTools.name: github_set_state
agentTools.description: Close or reopen a GitHub issue or pull request, optionally posting a comment first.

repo.description: owner/name; omit to use the current project's GitHub origin

reason.description: Issue close reason; ignored for PRs

comment.description: Optional comment posted before changing state

agentTools.name: github_runs
agentTools.description: List recent GitHub Actions workflow runs of a repository (defaults to the current project's origin). Returns id, name, title, number, status, conclusion, branch, and url.

repo.description: owner/name; omit to use the current project's GitHub origin

agentTools.name: github_run
agentTools.description: Get one Actions run with its jobs, steps, and annotations for failed jobs. Use github_job_log to read a job log.

repo.description: owner/name; omit to use the current project's GitHub origin

agentTools.name: github_job_log
agentTools.description: Read an Actions job log via the gh CLI. Returns lines around ##[error] when present, otherwise the last lines (default 150).

repo.description: owner/name; omit to use the current project's GitHub origin

lines.description: Tail length when the log has no ##[error] line. Default 150, max 1000

agentTools.name: github_run_action
agentTools.description: Rerun, rerun failed jobs, or cancel a GitHub Actions workflow run.

repo.description: owner/name; omit to use the current project's GitHub origin

agentTools.name: github_watch
agentTools.description: Watch GitHub repositories and deliver new events into this session as they happen: opened, ready, merged or closed PRs, new issues, @mentions of you, comments, and failed CI. The plugin polls each repository at most once a minute and wakes this session only when a filtered event arrives. One watch per session; calling again replaces it. Requires "Allow messages to any running session" in Settings → Plugins → GitHub.

repos.description: owner/name list, max 20; omit to use the current project's GitHub origin

events.description: Default pr_opened, pr_ready, pr_merged_closed, issue_opened, mention, ci_failed. pr_ready fires when a PR has had no new pushes for settleSec. mention covers @you, comments or reviews on your PRs/issues, and review requests

authors.description: Only PRs/issues (or CI runs) by these logins

excludeAuthors.description: Skip when the PR/issue author or the commenter/reviewer is one of these logins, e.g. dependabot[bot]

labels.description: Only PRs/issues with any of these labels; CI is not filtered by labels

includeDrafts.description: Default false: draft PRs only raise mention

branches.description: Branches checked for ci_failed, max 10. Default the repository's default branch

settleSec.description: Quiet time after the last push before pr_ready, 60-86400 seconds, default 900

debounceSec.description: Quiet period before a batch is delivered, 1-3600 seconds, default 3

minIntervalSec.description: Minimum gap between two deliveries, 0-86400 seconds, default 0

note.description: Standing instruction repeated with every delivery, max 500 characters

agentTools.name: github_unwatch
agentTools.description: Stop the github_watch subscription of this session.

agentTools.name: github_watch_status
agentTools.description: Show this session's github_watch: its settings, each repository's last and next poll, failures and errors, pending and delivered counts, the last delivery error, and the GitHub rate limit.
